title: Hendon Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency hospitals, urgent care, hazards, and supply points for Hendon and Colindale.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always call 999 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-hour A&E Hospitals:
- Royal Free Hospital: Pond Street, Hampstead NW3 2QG. Full 24-hour A&E. From Hendon Central Station: ~4 miles southeast along Watford Way (A41) and Finchley Road, or bus 113 to Swiss Cottage / Finchley Road.
- Barnet Hospital: Wellhouse Lane, Barnet EN5 3DJ. 24-hour A&E. From Hendon Central: ~6 miles north via A1 / A41 and Dollis Valley.
- St Mary's Hospital: Praed Street, London W2 1NY. Major Trauma Centre. Accessible south via the A41 corridor.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Edgware Community Hospital Walk-in Centre: Burnt Oak Broadway, Edgware HA8 0AD. From Colindale Station: ~2 miles north along A5 (Burnt Oak Broadway), or bus 32 / 142.
- Finchley Memorial Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Granville Road, North Finchley N12 0JE. ~3 miles northeast via North Circular Road (A406).

3. Local Hazards & Flood Risks:
- The Silk Stream flows through Colindale and Hendon into the Brent Reservoir (Welsh Harp); severe weather brings localized river and surface flooding along Edgware Road (A5) and adjacent residential roads.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
- Supermarkets, convenience retailers, and pharmacies along Hendon Central (Vivian Avenue / Queens Road), Brent Street, and Colindale Avenue supply drinking water, basic medical supplies, and offline necessities.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
